# recipes/forest_restoration/ — generated tables

**T4** (`T4_suitability_mappings.{csv,json}` + per-family `T4_forest_restoration__*.json`) comes from the T4 suitability sweeps (see `methodology/discovery_logs/forest_restoration_*`).

**T3 / T6 (added 2026-10-06):** `T3_nbs_hazard_farming.{csv,json}` and `T6_nbs_scorecard.{csv,json}` are GENERATED by `scripts/synthesise-t3t6.py forest_restoration` from the effect evidence (round 1, 2026-10-06: 23 WOCAT sheets through `ingest/wocat.py` + 51 literature / evaluation sources through five gated extraction lanes; 521 effect / asset units). No draft-0 seeds existed for this NbS, so there is no seed benchmark; the run report is `T3T6_synthesis_report.json`, the prose sidecar `T3T6_prose.json`. Families: active_planting · assisted_regeneration · passive_regeneration · mangrove_coastal · protection_cbfm (+ `forest_restoration__cross_family` for pooled results).
